risks.title: Live-tree apply has not been authorized
risks.detail: No role, token, or formal authorization grants permission to run atomic_swap against a real (non-throwaway) target tree. The bootstrap guard (_bootstrap_flag) enforces this boundary. Any promotion attempt without explicit written authorization violates the hard boundary in MB_INSTALL_V0_BUILD_SPEC.md.
risks.remediation: Explicit promotion authorization naming target tree, responsible principal, and Robert-auth token scope.

risks.title: GitHub Actions CI not independently observed by external connector
risks.detail: The mb-install-tests CI job fires on every push. The ChatGPT connector has not directly fetched CI run logs via GitHub API for commit 0b63bdc7. Repo-side evidence is strong but cross-check via CI artifact URL is pending.
risks.remediation: External connector fetches CI run log for commit 0b63bdc7 and confirms Ran 57 tests / OK.

risks.title: atomic_swap not exercised against a real target tree outside CI
risks.detail: Stage 4 atomic_swap is proven against a throwaway temp-dir in CI. No supervised rehearsal against a real (even non-protected) module install target has been performed.
risks.remediation: Single supervised rehearsal against an explicitly designated throwaway (non-OS, non-protected) tree, logged and attested.

risks.title: Protected-surface writes never exercised with a real Robert-auth token
risks.detail: FM-A proves check_protected_writes fails closed on empty/whitespace token. No test has supplied an actual non-empty Robert-auth token and written to a real protected surface. Token issuance and validation semantics are out of scope for v0.
risks.remediation: Token issuance and validation spec to be defined before protected-surface writes are attempted.

risks.title: External (non-Claude/non-ChatGPT) reproduction not yet performed
risks.detail: All reproduction performed within Claude Code agent environment or by ChatGPT connector verification. No independent human developer or third CI system has cloned the repo and run the suite.
risks.remediation: Any human developer running bash REPRODUCE.sh from the tested commit satisfies this. Required before production promotion; not required before limited promotion proposal.

risks.title: FM-B atomicity is single-agent scope only
risks.detail: restamp_sidecars() uses atomic temp+replace (os.replace). Concurrent-write safety from external processes during the replace window is not proven. Acceptable for v0 single-agent installs.
risks.remediation: Document in spec that FM-B atomicity is single-agent scope only.

risks.title: No re-verify hash check inside atomic_swap before rename (TOCTOU window)
risks.detail: stage_to_tmp re-verifies hashes after staging. atomic_swap does not re-verify before swapping. A TOCTOU window exists if the staging directory is writable by other processes between staging and swap.
risks.remediation: Stage 4+ could add a final hash check inside atomic_swap before rename. Low priority for single-agent installs.

promotion_path: RISK-01 blocks actual live-tree promotion only, not the proposal. All other risks are NONBLOCKING or DOCUMENTATION_ONLY. Limited promotion proposal is authorized to proceed.
